capabilities: Upload pasted images to an image host automatically
Upload all local images in a file via command
Download all remote images in a file to local storage
Upload images via context menu and drag-and-drop
Route uploads to different picbeds per vault via URL parameters
extras: Not tested on Mac; some paste-upload issues are traced to a PicGo 2.3.0-beta7 bug; download-all and server mode were only tested on Win10; Chinese documentation is available.
problem: Obsidian saves pasted images as local files in the vault; users who host images on an external image bed must upload and fix links by hand.
summary: Image uploader that sends pasted, dropped, or local images to image hosts via PicGo, PicList, or PicGo-Core and rewrites links.
